request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We are developing a sugar-free beer for people with this condition and want to size the target group per region.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised conditions and medications of patients aged 65 or older with atrial fibrillation who have no active oral anticoagulant.
definitions: Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Oral anticoagulant = ATC code starting with B01AA or B01AF.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Cohort = patients aged 65 or older on 31 December 2025 with atrial fibrillation and no active oral anticoagulant.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
